title: monogate-e3-trap-manifest.v1
description: 20 trap slots. The planted class of each trap is SEALED: it lives in answer_key.json, which is NOT in this repo until scoring. Only the key's SHA-256 is committed here, before any trap is evaluated.

answer_key_sha256.description: Committed BEFORE any evaluation. score_traps.py refuses to score a key that does not hash to this. Makes 'adjust the key after seeing the results' mechanically detectable rather than a matter of trust.

authored_by.description: MUST NOT be the system under test. See PROTOCOL.md E3 contamination warning.

planted_class.description: Literally the string 'sealed'. The real value (TRUE | SUBTLY_FALSE | MISFORMALIZED) is in answer_key.json only. If a real class appears here the experiment is void -- the manifest is in the repo the system can read.
